secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME
secrets.description: Optional. Cloudinary cloud name for real image uploads. Without it, image uploads fall back to local storage served at /uploads. Get it from https://cloudinary.com dashboard.

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Cloudinary API key (only needed if you want Cloudinary-hosted images instead of local storage).

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET
secrets.description: Optional. Cloudinary API secret (only needed if you want Cloudinary-hosted images instead of local storage).
